screens.text: A dua is a little prayer.

picture.alt: A boy holding up his hands to make dua

screens.text: When I wake up, I thank Allah.
Before I eat, I say: Bismillah.

picture.alt: Two children sharing a plate of dates

screens.text: Before I sleep, I say: Bismika Allahumma amutu wa ahya.

picture.alt: The moon in the night sky

screens.text: When I leave home, I say: Bismillah, tawakkaltu alallah.
After wudu, I say: Ash-hadu an la ilaha illallah.

picture.alt: A boy washing his hands under a tap

arabic.text: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ

screens.question: What do I say before I eat?

picture.alt: A boy holding up his hands to make dua
